name: Yorus Barleybrew
summary: At the Lakeshire Inn, Yorus Barleybrew awaits Alliance warriors bold enough to answer his challenge. Trainers across Alliance capitals send seasoned fighters from Stormwind toward the Redridge borderlands to meet the eccentric dwarf and face his test of arms.

sections.title: A Call to the Strong
sections.body: Across Alliance capitals, warrior trainers watch fighters who have outgrown their first drills. When an apprentice proves their mettle around their twentieth season, trainers such as Kelv Sternhammer, Wu Shen, and Darnath Bladesinger pass along word of Yorus Barleybrew. The dwarf offers no standard military order. Instead, he has issued an open wager and a test of arms to any Alliance warrior bold enough to answer.

sections.title: Waiting in Lakeshire
sections.body: Yorus Barleybrew waits at the tavern in Lakeshire, on the front lines of Redridge's struggle against encroaching gnolls and Blackrock orcs. Those who find him meet a boastful dwarf with a hearty drink in hand, ready to judge any challenger who claims true fighting spirit. For warriors seeking to prove themselves beyond the capital's safe cobbled streets, his trial opens onto the harsher battles of the frontier.

faq.answer: Yorus Barleybrew is a dwarf of the famous Barleybrew brewing clan who has issued an open martial challenge to Alliance warriors. He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, where he tests fighters who believe they are ready for the brutal frontier of Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why do the trainers send warriors to Redridge?
faq.answer: When a warrior has gained sufficient skill in Stormwind, local weapon masters send them toward practical, high-stakes combat. Yorus Barleybrew's trial takes trainees beyond the city walls, where they prove their endurance against real wilderness threats.

faq.q: Where can I find Yorus Barleybrew?
faq.answer: Yorus Barleybrew waits inside the Lakeshire Inn, in the town of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, just east of Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Yorus?
faq.answer: Speaking with Yorus begins his martial trial: the Rethban Gauntlet, a perilous test against the vicious beasts and gnolls in the surrounding hills.

faq.q: Who offers the quest to find him?
faq.answer: Warrior trainers in the Alliance capitals, including Kelv Sternhammer, Wu Shen, and Darnath Bladesinger, send warriors to find Yorus once they have proven basic competence.

faq.q: Is this trial open to classes other than warriors?
faq.answer: No. Yorus Barleybrew offers this challenge only to warriors, martial combatants who rely on physical endurance and arms.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you face a rite of passage from introductory drills to dangerous trials on the Redridge frontier.
As an Alliance recruit, you may be sent to Lakeshire, a vulnerable settlement beset by gnolls and Blackrock orcs.
